targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(drain_rate_pct_per_hour)::numeric/100, 4), 0) FROM vampire_drain_events WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(range_lost_km)::numeric, 1), 0) FROM vampire_drain_events WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(duration_hours)::numeric, 1), 0) FROM vampire_drain_events WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vampire_drain_events WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(drain_rate_pct_per_hour)::numeric/100, 4), 0) FROM vampire_drain_events WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND sentry_mode = TRUE AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(drain_rate_pct_per_hour)::numeric/100, 4), 0) FROM vampire_drain_events WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND sentry_mode = FALSE AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
SELECT start_date AS time, drain_rate_pct_per_hour FROM vampire_drain_events WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date) ORDER BY start_date

panels.title: Duration vs Drain Rate (Sentry Mode Comparison)

targets.rawSql: SELECT start_date AS time, drain_rate_pct_per_hour AS sentry_on FROM vampire_drain_events WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND sentry_mode = TRUE AND $__timeFilter(start_date) ORDER BY start_date
SELECT start_date AS time, drain_rate_pct_per_hour AS sentry_off FROM vampire_drain_events WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND sentry_mode = FALSE AND $__timeFilter(start_date) ORDER BY start_date

SELECT start_date, end_date, start_battery, end_battery, battery_lost, range_lost_km, duration_hours, drain_rate_pct_per_hour, outside_temp_avg, sentry_mode FROM vampire_drain_events WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date) ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 100

list.name: vehicle_id
list.query: SELECT id AS __value, COALESCE(display_name, vin) AS __text FROM vehicles ORDER BY id
